project_name: Aurum Capital Ventures Merrick County Data Center
aliases: Merrick County Section 11 Township 15 Range 4 data center
status_detail: Merrick County Board tabled action after an April 28, 2026 public hearing, then on May 12, 2026 approved the conditional use permit for a data center at 11-15-4 NW 1/4 NW 1/4 PID 292.00 with a decommissioning plan, landowner lease, and bond.
notes: County minutes identify Charlie White with Aurum Capital Ventures and say taxable valuation would be approximately $300,000,000. Polk County Rural Public Power District recommended approval and county was told it would be a closed-loop system not continuously using water. No MW capacity found.
